title: Lemurs Machine Learning Repository
summary: A machine learning pipeline for the LEMURS study that extracts passive behavioral data (screentime, health metrics, audio) and survey-derived mental-health labels from PostgreSQL, then trains classical ML and PyTorch models to predict risk outcomes. Its unused synthetic-data module imports CTGAN from the unrelated 'sdgx' library, not from SDV's ctgan package, so the CTGAN reference is a name collision rather than genuine SDV usage.
evidence: src/synthetic_data_generation/synthetic_data.py:6-9 imports CTGANSynthesizerModel from sdgx, not sdv/ctgan; README notes module 'not used'
needs: Confirm sdgx (Synthetic Data Generation for tabular data) has no dependency on SDV internals; current evidence shows it is a separate library.
